records.what_changed: Closed the review's open warning that the verifier assumed serial adapter calls and would be unsafe if a real model issued parallel tool calls (framework commit 98fb46a05babc8b208f2d38c03cc1f4a224d3a50). Reproduced the race first: next_seq was an unlocked read-modify-write and the log line was written after execution, so firing twelve concurrent calls against the pre-fix code produced nine of twelve lines with zero duplicate sequence numbers and a perfectly contiguous one-to-nine range on one run, and eleven of twelve lines with two duplicates and a gap on another. The first form is the dangerous one because three calls vanished while the surviving log looked entirely self-consistent, which means log self-consistency was never evidence of log completeness and only an external expected-count invariant catches it. The fix makes the adapter hold an exclusive lock, msvcrt on Windows and fcntl elsewhere, across sequence allocation, execution and logging, so concurrent calls queue rather than interleave and serialisation becomes an enforced property instead of an assumption, with sequence numbers unique and contiguous and log order equal to execution order. Each line now also records pid and lock_wait_ms, and a non-zero wait is direct evidence that the harness issued overlapping tool calls, which is one of the specific things the upcoming real-session smoke needs to discover. The verifier no longer depends on ordering at all: the verb and argument-digest join became a counted multiset and the shared stdout digest is matched within each call's fingerprint pool rather than by position, so parallelism cannot be papered over by an accidental ordering, and new checks assert sequence uniqueness and contiguity while a NOTE line reports how many calls waited on the lock. A new concurrency suite fires twelve genuinely concurrent calls with container execution stubbed and requires every call to exit zero, every line to be valid JSON, exactly one line per call, no duplicate or non-contiguous sequence numbers, distinct pids, and that contention was actually observed so the lock is exercised rather than merely present; that suite was confirmed to fail against the pre-fix code. In the mutation suite the check that the adapter and transcript disagree on call order was retired, because reordering is deliberately no longer a failure once each line carries its own sequence number and the joins ignore order, and it was replaced by the two real race signatures, a shared sequence number and a missing line leaving a gap. Suites now stand at eighty-eight, fourteen, eighteen and eight checks all passing, with the artifact-only verifier at seventeen of seventeen against the committed canary evidence, up from fifteen. The frozen baseline hook, both amendments, the three frozen v1 packets and both signed candidates remain byte-stable. Gate 2 remains at zero of four arms and zero of two scorers.
records.next_step: The evidence pipeline now survives parallel tool calls, so the real-session smoke can be run without its artifacts being ambiguous. That smoke must be a fresh, disposable Claude Code task, not this session and not a subagent of it, because the guard hooks live in session-wide settings and configuring them here would deny this session's own tool calls. Its only purpose is to capture authentic hook payloads on a throwaway target and answer four questions: whether tool_use_id is supplied on PreToolUse, PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure alike, whether an exit-0 deny JSON is honoured as a block, which post event a non-zero Bash exit produces, and the real shape of tool_response. The new lock_wait_ms field additionally reveals whether the harness issues overlapping tool calls at all. Destroy that task afterwards and do not reuse it as a producer. Only then provision four answer-blind producers and two arm-identity-blind scorers, verify per context that the hooks are actually active since enforcement is harness-scoped, and confirm identity, blinding, tree hash 36c346fa, image digest, model build, permissions and dispatch order D C A B without executing any arm. Formal start still requires a separate owner command.
